info.name: Solaris Zones Oracle Solaris Kernel Zones Kernel Zone…
info.description:
REST API for creating and managing Oracle Solaris Kernel Zones via the RAD zonemgr module. Kernel Zones (brand solaris-kz) are non-global zones with their own kernel, providing greater independence and enhanced security isolation compared to native zones. They support live migration, independent patching, and hardware-assisted virtualization.

Contact Support:
 Name: Oracle Solaris Support
 Email: solaris-support@oracle.com

item.name: Solaris Zones Install a Kernel Zone

request.description: Install a configured kernel zone. This provisions the zone with its own Solaris kernel, creating an independent operating environment with hardware-assisted virtualization support.
